messages:
Jamie: Starting a quick GTM Q&A thread post-all-hands. Drop rapid questions about pipeline, pricing, partners. Maria and Leah will field.
Maria: TL;DR pipeline looks good overall. Top-heavy in mid-market; a few large enterprises closing in Q3. Happy to share action items.
Sanjay: Are we relaxing discount approvals for renewals this quarter? Seeing push from a couple of bigger accounts.
Maria: No blanket relaxation. We allowed an interim +5% discretionary uplift for strategic renewals with approvals from Sales Ops + CSM. Anything more needs VP sign-off.
Leah: Partner launch Q: when does the reseller program go live? EMEA partners are asking.
Leah: Launch date May 15 for Partner Growth tier. Key points: 15% rev share for certified resellers, co-sell credits, and an 8-partner co-marketing pilot. Enablement kit next week.
Darren: Does the pilot force partners to commit spend? Some prefer no-commit pilots.
Leah: No upfront money. Requirement: register 3 qualified opps/quarter to qualify for co-marketing funds.
Olivia: Packaging question: will Dedicated be offered as explicit reserved SKUs or stick with token pricing? Need to update docs.
Maria: Both. Reserved-capacity SKUs for Dedicated (monthly tiers + overage rate) and per-token hosted pricing with volume breaks. Sales ops will publish SKU matrix.
Sanjay: Short line for proposals about quantization/cost savings? Ops wants something non-technical.
Olivia: Use: "We offer model/quantization profiles that can lower inference costs up to ~40% for high-throughput workloads while maintaining quality; we’ll recommend profiles during onboarding."
Jamie: Forecasting change: weekly rollups for top 25 deals starting Friday. Sales lead — push RFC by EOD tomorrow.
Maria: Action list: (1) Leah posts partner kit & FAQ by Monday, (2) Olivia drops 1-line cost blurb today, (3) Sales Ops publishes SKU/discount guardrails tomorrow.
Sanjay: Can we get a 1-slide summary of partner tiers for APAC reps?
Leah: Ill create a 2-slide summary and drop in #all-hands-decks. Will loop in PMM.
all-hands-bot: Recording and slides will be uploaded to the all-hands folder within 24 hours.
Jamie: Thanks everyone. If follow-ups, ping Maria/Leah or add here. Leadership will review progress in next week's GTM sync. :rocket:
